checks.name: Calendar coverage
checks.detail: estr 100.0% of business days (longest gap 0); sofr 100.0% of business days (longest gap 1); tona 96.7% of business days (longest gap 4); dfr 100.0% of business days (longest gap 0); bund10_daily 99.2% of business days (longest gap 1); oat10_daily 99.9% of business days (longest gap 1). The Japanese calendar omits moving holidays, so a few count as gaps.

checks.name: Ranges
checks.detail: 37 rate series within -1.5%..12.0% (yields -1.5%..40.0%); MMSR collateral-specific rates -2.66%..4.02% (specials allowed down to -5.0%); no negative volumes.

checks.name: Negative-rate periods
checks.detail: DFR negative on 100% of days 2014-06-11..2022-07-26 and non-negative on 100% of other days; BoJ policy rate negative on 100% of days 2016-02-16..2024-03-20; median TONA in that window -0.041%.

checks.name: Spot checks
checks.detail: 5 published values match (e.g. SOFR 5.25% on 17 Sep 2019).

checks.name: Bund: Bundesbank daily vs ECB monthly
checks.detail: 225 months; mean absolute difference 4.4 bp (the ECB convergence series uses a benchmark basket, the Bundesbank the current 10-year bond).

checks.name: OAT: Webstat daily vs ECB monthly
checks.detail: 263 months; mean absolute difference 1.8 bp (mean -0.8 bp; TEC10 is a constant-maturity interpolation, the ECB series a benchmark basket). Monthly changes of the daily-based OAT-Bund spread correlate 0.93 with the ECB-based spread.

checks.name: Euro liquidity proxy
checks.detail: 110 weeks; median |proxy - excess liquidity - reserve requirements| EUR 0 bn.

checks.name: Market rates vs policy corridors
checks.detail: EFFR inside the Fed target range on 100.0% of days; median |TONA - BoJ policy rate| since Mar 2016 4.8 bp; median |MMSR S/N repo - DFR| 8.0 bp.

checks.name: Publication lags
checks.detail: every daily series is within its publication lag (plus 7 business days) of the fetch date; nothing is dated in the future.
